claims.claim: Added one pinned TASK_AUTHORING-only TCA-1 profile with five construct checks, six adversarial challenges, two focused passes and one final closure.

TCA binds Human intent, TASK proposal, authorization and consumers; requires exact acceptance accounting, claimability declarations and falsifying cases; blocks PROOF_LATER acceptance and unchanged phase relabeling.
Adversarial checks require counterexamples. Every first-pass blocker survives unless explicitly resolved using bound sources and a lawful candidate with changed anchors.

The existing provider-neutral protocol transports bound TCA stages and closures, revalidates identities and lineage, enforces privacy and bounds, and requires freshness between passes and before return.
Isolated V1_ONLY interoperability requires an externally supplied Human selection bound to the exact subject and V1 profile. Mixed audits, ordinary TCA selection and V3 fallback are rejected.
Historical V1/V2/V3 and published ROA/MOA profile contents and legacy protocol paths are retained; registry membership remains limited to six recognized identities.

Added focused positive and negative regressions for acceptance phases and coverage, consumer and scope conflicts, false completion, retained blockers, binding substitutions, Human options and historical digests.

The commit changes only the eight authorized files. Direct authoring, production selection policy, lifecycle mechanisms, roadmap, Kernel and downstream files remain untouched; documentation makes no superiority or cutover claim.
